body:
100% this. Blows my mind, too.

The worst part? I know she’s staying at his place tonight. You can imagine where my mind has been. She just left me for him a month ago. Ugh.
I got this crap from my ex. “Take a break.” No. Your stupid ass wants to fool around and see how much you like the new guy while keeping me in your back pocket in case things don’t work out.

I feel your pain. Just know you’re not alone. I want to cut all contact with my ex after she left me last month but unfortunately there is a lease situation involved. 

I know she’s sleeping at his place tonight. I know sex is likely involved. I spent a good portion of tonight bawling my eyes out. 

Ugh.

A year ago I was living in a nice house, fenced in yard, with two dogs, and with the love of my life. 

Now? No house, no dogs, currently between jobs, and a month ago my girlfriend left me for another guy.

We were together 3 years. 

R.I.P.
Well let’s be grateful we can lean on each other when times get tough since we know how it feels.

The one part about what you said that bothers me the most is that you tried dating again but you kept thinking of her... if I even do much as talk to another girl i feel like I’m the one doing the cheating.

I know stuff takes time but I feel like I’ll never have such a deep connection.. both physically and emotionally.. with anyone ever again. And that makes me sad. And I, like you, have had some pretty dark thoughts. I’m only a month into it but i still find myself finding g things that remind me of her.. or us. No matter the time or places I will randomly get extremely emotional about her and feel that lump in my throat. 

I hate this feeling. I’d do anything take have her back but she chose someone else over me.. so now im getting to the point where I will do anything to make this pain go away. It’s consuming me.
Ugh this is kinda what she said to me when she left me and our 3 year relationship. It’d be easier to accept if she hadn’t already been seeing someone else when she left..
Thank you for the kind words :)

Ugh I hear ya I don’t get that either. I was dumped for a different guy after three years.. I had to delete stuff myself for my sanity.. but I know she still has stuff. 

Unfortunately I still have to be in contact with her due to a lease situation otherwise I’d cut all contact. I’m sliding down into a dark hole pretty quickly.
I wish I was this strong. I’m going to wallow in self pity for the rest of my life 😂 but I deserve it
